`final class FontFile`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.tool.msdf.font` · **Module:** `tool-msdf` · **Source:** [FontFile.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/msdf/src/main/java/dev/joid/tool/msdf/font/FontFile.java)

The tables of a TrueType or OpenType file, read for the weight, the style and the kerning that the font of Java does not give.

- [MSDF text](/use/in-depth/msdf-text/)

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `int` | [getWeight](#FontFile-method-getWeight)() | Returns the weight of the `OS/2` table, `400` without it. |
| `int` | [getUnitsPerEm](#FontFile-method-getUnitsPerEm)() | Returns the units per em of the `head` table, `1000` without it. |
| `Map<String,Integer>` | [getTables](#FontFile-method-getTables)() | Returns the offset of each table by tag, read-only. |

| `int` | [integer](#FontFile-method-integer)(int offset) | Returns the 32-bit value at that offset. |
